description: Reply to a RECEIVED email by its id. This sends a REAL email back to the original sender, so confirm the content with the user before calling. The reply goes from the address the original arrived at (falling back to the workspace's primary address) with a 'Re:' subject. Counts against the monthly send quota. On failure returns { error, message } instead of throwing.

id.description: Id of the received email to reply to

subject.description: Override subject; defaults to Re: <original subject>

name: reply_to_email
